node.statement: From rho_Upsilon=min{rho_unit,rho_Upsilon',[2*(C_T+C_Upsilon')]^(-1)} and 0<=eta<=rho_Upsilon, one has eta<=rho_unit, eta<=rho_Upsilon', and eta<=[2*(C_T+C_Upsilon')]^(-1). Applying lem-routef-raw-factor-units and lem-routef-upsilon-prime-closeness gives ||tilde-Upsilon(I)-I||<=C_T*eta, Upsilon' CP, and ||Upsilon'-tilde-Upsilon||_cb<=C_Upsilon'*eta.
